title: Book 8 — Urania, Chapter 54
paragraphs: Xerxes, having now taken full possession of Athens, sent a mounted messenger to Susa to report to Artabanos their success. On the day after sending the herald, he called together the Athenian exiles who were accompanying him and ordered them to go up to the Acropolis and sacrifice the victims in their own customary manner — whether because he had seen some vision in a dream that made him give this command, or because he had a scruple in his mind for having set fire to the temple. The Athenian exiles did as they were commanded.
